name: RadioCard
description: Card-style radio button with room for a label or longer text, for picking one option from a set. Use inside `RadioGroup.Root`. Renders a `<span>` element and a hidden `<input>` beside it.

props.name: value
props.description: The unique identifying value of the radio in a group.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the radio card as invalid, applying error styles. Sets `aria-invalid` on the `<span>` element. Inside an invalid `RadioGroup.Root`, the card is always invalid.

props.name: children
props.description: Content shown inside the card, such as a label or a short description of the option.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the element, or a function that returns a class based on the component’s state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: A ref to access the hidden input element.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description:
Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it
via the `render` prop.
Set to `true` if the rendered element is a native button.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the user should be unable to select the radio button.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the user must choose a value before submitting a form.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the element, or a function that returns a style object based on the component’s state.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: RadioCard.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
